==Problem==

What is the greatest possible sum of the digits in the base-seven representation of a positive integer less than <imath>2019</imath>?

<imath>\textbf{(A) } 11
\qquad\textbf{(B) } 14
\qquad\textbf{(C) } 22
\qquad\textbf{(D) } 23
\qquad\textbf{(E) } 27</imath>

==Solution 1==

Observe that <imath>2019_{10} = 5613_7</imath>. To maximize the sum of the digits, we want as many <imath>6</imath>s as possible (since <imath>6</imath> is the highest value in base <imath>7</imath>), and this will occur with either of the numbers <imath>4666_7</imath> or <imath>5566_7</imath>. Thus, the answer is <imath>4+6+6+6 = 5+5+6+6 = \boxed{\textbf{(C) }22}</imath>.

==Solution 2==

Note that all base <imath>7</imath> numbers with <imath>5</imath> or more digits are in fact greater than <imath>2019</imath>. Since the first answer that is possible using a <imath>4</imath> digit number is <imath>23</imath>, we start with the smallest base <imath>7</imath> number that whose digits sum to <imath>23</imath>, namely <imath>5666_7</imath>. But this is greater than <imath>2019_{10}</imath>, so we continue by trying <imath>4666_7</imath>, which is less than 2019. So the answer is <imath>\boxed{\textbf{(C) }22}</imath>.

==Solution 3==

Again note that you want to maximize the number of <imath>6</imath>s to get the maximum sum.  Note that <imath>666_7=342_{10}</imath>, so you have room to add a thousands digit base <imath>7</imath>.  Fix the <imath>666</imath> in place and try different thousands digits, to get <imath>4666_7</imath> as the number with the maximum sum of digits.  The answer is <imath>\boxed{\textbf{(C)} 22}</imath>.

~mwu2010

Note: The reason <imath>5666</imath> base <imath>7</imath> doesn't work is because it would be greater than <imath>2019</imath>. <imath>5666</imath> base <imath>7</imath>=<imath>2057</imath>

<imath>6666</imath> doesn't work either, because <imath>6666</imath> is greater than <imath>5666</imath>

==Solution 4 (Answer Choices - based on Solution 1)==

Using answer choices, since it says greatest, you would start at the right half of the answer choices. <imath>\textbf{(D) }  23</imath>, would be at greatest, <imath>5666</imath>, and <imath>6+6\cdot7+6\cdot49+5\cdot343 = 2057</imath>. <imath>2057 > 2019</imath>, so instead of <imath>5666</imath>, it could be <imath>4666</imath>. <imath>6+6\cdot7+6\cdot49+4\cdot343 = 1714</imath>, and <imath>1714 < 2019</imath>, so the answer will be <imath>4+6+6+6 = \boxed{\textbf{(C) }22}</imath>

Disclaimer: Instead of <imath>4666</imath>, it could be <imath>6466</imath>, <imath>6646</imath>, etc., but <imath>4666</imath> is gone to first, because it will ensure that it is almost certain for the base 10 representation of the base 7 number to be <imath>< 2019</imath>.
